posts.subject: Surf Rpg DM Suggestion.
posts.bodyHtml:
Heey there guys, I've a suggestion for the !shop.


1. I've been asked multiple times to ask you guys to fix the chicken ( pet ) from what i've heard you can't equip it.
2. Can you guys add some new titles to the server ? Something like *Awper* * ( IF this is possible )
Besides awper I belive you guys can make up some more =D


Sub-Suggestions:


Drewfire
UltraLow
TheConArtist
Unreal
Fury


Just a couple of well known examples . [thanksforit*]

I agree with more titles to be added to the chat features section of the store on the server(s). Possibly, there could be custom titles for donors and members of the forum. Another thing I suggest also for the chat features is a much wider scope of colours available for the titles and text. This is because green, red, grey and white is a bit limited. Perhaps blue, purple, yellow and orange could be available. Perhaps a custom colour system can be added with a hexadecimal chat input to change the colour for a certain amount of points.

@Fiddles
Yellow and some other colors like blue (?) are donator exclusive. And also, there are already custom titles for donors like | ☆ Donator ☆ |. Those items are available in the donator store.
